claims.title: Physical shear: coupled certificates, balanced loops and nonlinear actuator obstructions

quoted_fields.interface: Unit three-torus, physical Navier-Stokes with ordinary additive force, full stretching term retained. Fixed rational trigonometric actuators; unknown mean-zero divergence-free initial H1 ball and additive L-infinity-time L2 disturbances; one prescribed force for all initial states/weak realizations. Each component below has its explicit linear/inviscid/fixed-fibre/planar/small-basin or restricted-family hypotheses. Earlier extra-advection controllers obey different equations.
quoted_fields.failure: No full common-force/all-H1/allweak theorem or general impossibility over all finite actuator families. Fixed noncritical fibre decay is not uniform decay over every Fourier sector. Four-moment linear echo retains transient amplification; smooth planar nonlinear echo excludes genuinely 3D inter-sector interactions and transverse disturbance. All-weak robust return only covers an exponentially small initial L2 basin, not radius M>=1. Collinear and common-curl-eigenspace obstructions are exact nonlinear restricted-family results. Earlier inviscid echoes, finite nets and extra-advection constructions retain their scopes. Original E104 Hilbert-Schmidt certificate is explicitly corrected by the supplied ROOT operator-norm test; raw source bytes are preserved. Critical-complement damping leaves anomalous kernel forcing, background removal/rational approximation and nonlinear closure open. Known near-Kolmogorov nonlinear counterexamples block a naive linear-to-nonlinear transfer, not every forced multidirectional controller.
